summary: You present a clear Australia-relevant reef-monitoring concept, identify scientific and conservation users, and provide a useful week-by-week Gantt chart and relevant sources. Your main opportunity is to turn the broad concept and research activity into measurable mission requirements and preliminary technical results, while strengthening the plan’s contingencies and report referencing.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, distinguish ocean acidification from warming-driven heat stress as causes of bleaching, then specify the sensor, spectral capability, coverage, revisit and data-latency needs that follow from your users’ requirements.

In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, explicitly select STK and add dependencies, decision milestones and contingency actions to your Gantt chart. Tie each planned task to the sources and evidence it will use.

Before the next submission, produce and interpret initial technical results—for example, an orbit and coverage simulation or a payload trade study—and present them clearly. Use consistent in-text citations and a formatted reference list.

criteria.C1: Your Mission Concept & Rationale establishes the reef-monitoring need, identifies scientific and conservation users, and supports the concept with sources. To strengthen the mission definition, separate acidification from heat-driven bleaching and set measurable sensor, coverage, revisit and latency requirements.
criteria.C2: Your Project Plan & Preliminary Progress includes a week-by-week Gantt chart, task descriptions and useful source links. To reach the next level, explain task dependencies and decision criteria, add contingencies, explicitly name STK as your selected software, and connect sources to specific tasks.
criteria.C3: You report relevant background research and completing STK tutorials 1–4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress. To demonstrate stronger technical progress, include initial calculations, simulation outputs or a payload trade study, with brief interpretation of what the results mean for mission feasibility.
criteria.C4: Your report uses clear headings, readable prose and a labelled Gantt chart. To improve its professional presentation, format sources consistently as in-text citations and a reference list, and make the chart show milestones and dependencies clearly.
